en.title: Pascal's Triangle
en.description: Given a non-negative integer numRows, return the first numRows rows of Pascal's triangle.
en.output: Output a compact JSON 2D integer array; output [] when numRows=0.
en.explanation: Build each new row from the sums of adjacent elements in the previous row. See the accompanying notes for the full solution.
hints: The first and last elements of each row are 1; each inner element equals the sum of the two adjacent elements in the previous row.
